hits.title: Realtime Robotics Names Kevin Carlin Chief Executive Officer to Lead Company’s Next Phase of Growth - Realtime Robotics
hits.snippet: BOSTON – August 13, 2026 – Realtime Robotics, the leader in industrial AI for automated robot system design and deployment, today announced that Kevin Carlin has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately. BOSTON – August 13, 2026 – Realtime Robotics, the leader in industrial AI for automated robot system design and deployment, today announced that Kevin Carlin has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately. Carlin brings more than two decades of international leadership in semiconductors, industrial automation, and AI to the role. He joined Realtime Robotics in 2022 as Chief Commercial Officer and was promoted to President and Chief Commercial Officer in 2025. Prior to Realtime Robotics, Carlin spent more than 13 years at Analog Devices, where he most recently built an internal startup focused on AI- and machine learning-driven sensing and analytics. Realtime Robotics’ Resolver platform automates and optimizes the most complex aspects of factory planning and robot system design and deployment.
